Check for item 26 and item 10 together: `etude eval FILE` on this computer, for an eval-only file whose play function calls an outside service using this machine's own environment, seating a checkpoint another experiment stored. The checkpoint is fetched here from the source and nothing is rented. Jack Heart: "this system should still not rule out the idea of evals just running locally on the client machine ... you get the keys that you have". Cover it with a test whose play reads an environment variable.
